lessonTitle: 71. Ratio of areas of similar triangles
lessonTitleEnglish: Ratio of areas of similar triangles
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: The ratio of the areas of similar triangles equals the square of the similarity coefficient: S₁ : S = k².
stages.headlineEnglish: The ratio of the areas of similar triangles equals the square of the similarity coefficient: S₁ : S = k².

stages.headline: Example: with k = 2 the larger triangle is made of 4 copies of the smaller one.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: with k = 2 the larger triangle is made of 4 copies of the smaller one.

stages.headline: Example: the small triangle has area 5 and k = 3, so the large one has 5 · 9 = 45.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: the small triangle has area 5 and k = 3, so the large one has 5 · 9 = 45.

stages.headline: The similarity coefficient is 3. What is the ratio of areas?
stages.headlineEnglish: The similarity coefficient is 3. What is the ratio of areas?
